question: In which of the following Five-Year Plans was removal of poverty and attainment of self-reliance the main objective?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fifth Five-Year Plan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-1978) aimed at removing poverty and attaining self-reliance through the promotion of economic growth, social justice, and self-reliance.
 
• This plan was formulated and launched under the guidance of D.P. Dhar and was approved during the tenure of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.
 
• The plan focused on increasing the income levels of the poor and providing employment opportunities to reduce poverty.
 
• It emphasized the reduction of inequalities in income and wealth distribution, and the expansion of the agriculture sector to ensure food security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans in India**

 
 
• The Five-Year Plans were centralized and integrated national economic programs. Initially, they were implemented by the Planning Commission of India.
 
• The First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956) focused on the agricultural sector, aiming to increase food production and improve the living standards of the rural population.
 
• The Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961) prioritized industrialization, especially heavy industries and the public sector.
 
• Each subsequent plan aimed at addressing specific economic challenges faced by the country, with a long-term vision for balanced and sustainable growth.
 
 
 
• **Poverty Alleviation Programs in India**
 
 
• Various poverty alleviation programs have been launched in India, such as the Integrated Rural Development Program (IRDP), National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA), and the Public Distribution System (PDS).
 
• The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) provides legal guarantees for at least 100 days of wage employment in a year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• These programs aim to provide direct assistance to the poor and promote economic development through job creation and social support.
